# easydns_service (Data Source)

```terraform
data "easydns_service" "current" {
  service_id = data.easydns_domain.example.service_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_id` (Number) Positive EasyDNS service ID.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Service description.
- `enterprise` (Boolean) Whether this is an enterprise service.
- `name` (String) Service name.
- `period` (Number) Service term, usually in months.
